description: A new workflow (a draft). Its target is the person's JSON Schema, else our standard schema. With the person's own schema, map its fields next: triage_target proposes where each field comes from and save_draft saves the mappings; until a field has a mapping it comes out empty. Then add_sample, check the values with preview_sample, then preview_publish and publish_workflow.

schema.description: The person's JSON Schema (or an example of their JSON).

schema_file.description: Or the path of that file.

name: create_workflow
title: Create a workflow
